_comment: EXAMPLE per-volume price table with made-up publishers, series and prices. EUR CENTS (integer).
To use your own: copy this file to source-exports/price-table.json and edit it (that path is git-ignored).
seriesVolumeOverrides -> seriesOverrides -> publisherEdition -> publisherStandard -> oneShotCents -> defaultCents
oneShotCents sits BELOW publisherStandard on purpose: a one-shot is only assumed pricier when the publisher is unknown.
Series keys must match series.canonical_title EXACTLY.
